notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Scans a network range (CIDR or octet range) for host discovery and open ports. Combined with -sn (ping scan only) for initial host discovery or with port flags for full scanning.

=== HOST DISCOVERY FIRST ===
Always run host discovery (-sn) before port scanning a range — identify live hosts, then target only those for service enumeration. Scanning 65535 ports against 254 dead hosts wastes time.

=== ARP vs ICMP ===
On local segments: Nmap uses ARP first (Layer 2, bypasses firewall rules). Cross-segment: ICMP echo. Use --disable-arp-ping to force ICMP if ARP results differ from expected.
